ENGLISH MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ENGLISH MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. quickly
   B. blue
   C. run
   D. happiness

2. When practising Reading 1.2.1 Reading Fluency: Argumentative texts, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.1 Reading Fluency: Argumentative texts.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.1 Reading Fluency: Argumentative texts.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.1 Reading Fluency: Argumentative texts.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.1 Reading Fluency: Argumentative texts.

3. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library?
   B. Where is the Library
   C. where is the library
   D. Where is the library

4. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.4.1 Sentence skills: Sentence fluency ● avoiding ambiguity in pronoun .
   D. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.4.1 Sentence skills: Sentence fluency ● avoiding ambiguity in pronoun .

   A. goed
   B. going
   C. goes
   D. went

   B. Only a describing word
   C. Only an action
   D. A person, place, thing, or idea

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Selective Listening: ● filtering information ● extr; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Reading 9.2.1 Close reading; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Critical reading; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
